items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: But Bunk would come over to Crowley and play with our band. Well I was an Ike Jenkins drummer. And that's how I got a chance to play with Bunk Johnson.

ctx.x: You know, Bunk Johnson always called him Louie Nelson. They always called him Dr. Nelson's son, is the way I always spoke of him.
Oh yeah, Bunk Johnson. Now by the way, speaking of Bunk Johnson-
Do you remember hearing him when you-
